description: Expanding the old-language reduct of an actual \(L_R\)-structure by its own added relation recovers that identical structure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.expansion_recovers.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  {M : Type w} (S : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Structure M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.expansion fun a =>
      FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap (Sum.inr Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.AddedRelation.fresh)
        a) =
    S
